prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save your pet to your account", "Sign in now to sync your new desktop companion across devices and prevent pet loss."]
1: ["Choose your desktop companion", "Select a companion style that fits your desktop environment.", "Select companion"]
2: ["Official Adoption Complete!", "Your companion certificate is registered."]
3: ["Preparing your pet's desktop home...", "We are generating your companion graphics. You can safely minimize this window.", "Generation progress"]
4: ["How would you like to create your pet?", "Choose Instant Adoption for ready-to-play pets or Custom Studio to create from photo.", "Fastest (30 seconds)", "Adoption Path"]
5: ["Sign in to keep your pet saved", "Connecting your account ensures your companion profile is backed up safely.", "Using the same account email recovers existing desktop pets automatically.", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Email"]
6: ["Upload a clear photo for best pet generation", "For optimal results, follow these photo tips before rendering.", "Use well-lit front facing photos", "Select Photo"]
7: ["Your pet is almost ready to leap onto your desktop!", "When finished, your pet will appear at the bottom right corner of your main desktop screen.", "Check your system tray if the pet window is obscured by active apps."]
8: ["Your Pet is Live!", "Right-click your pet on desktop anytime for options menu, or drag to move around.", "Double-click to open chat box. Right click system tray icon to hide/show.", "Start Playing"]
9: ["Welcome to your virtual desktop sanctuary", "Bring your computer screen to life with an interactive desktop companion that lives alongside your daily work.", "Begin Setup"]
